record.hypothesis: Replace pairwise BPR with pointwise logistic loss: average softplus(-positive_score)+softplus(negative_score) over valid target positions. Keep the existing sampled positives and negatives, masking, model, scoring, optimizer, scheduler and training settings unchanged. Separately constraining positive and negative scores may learn more useful score magnitudes and improve HR@10 versus optimizing only their difference. Train and retain one checkpoint per category.
